## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] If the web workspace changed: `python scripts/check_webapp.py` passes locally
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/measurement-protocol.md`, or `docs/data-contract.md`) if
      user-facing behavior, metrics, or the data contract changed
- [ ] No third-party runtime dependency was added without prior discussion in an issue
- [ ] Any new example data under `examples/` is clearly synthetic
